description: Turn target portfolio weights into the whole-share orders that move your paper account there (sells first), check them, and return a confirmation token when all pass.

allow_leverage.description: Allow gross weight above 1; default false.

fees.description: Your fee schedule, if any (Alpaca equities: no commission).

limits.description: Tighten your limits file for this call only (e.g. {"max_order_notional": 5000}).

liquidate_others.description: Sell holdings not in target_weights; default false.
